title: The Letters of Port Alder
author: Quentin Ravensworth
blurb: Edmund Sterling, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
